description:
List Outreach tasks. Example: { "status": "incomplete" } or { "prospect_id": "123" }

Returns tasks with status, due date, type, and assigned user.

page_offset.description: Record offset into the result list for pagination (maps to the API's page[offset]; e.g. 25 for the second page with limit 25)

prospect_id.description: Filter tasks for a specific prospect

name: outreach_list_tasks
